ownerSignOff.statement: The release owner explicitly requested stable publication of 0.3.3 and selected an AWS-only owner-approved exception in place of stored acceptance reports. Canonical trace analysis acceptance remains pending because analysis is disabled by operator decision. This approval does not establish exact-artifact clean installation, successful analysis and Dashboard acknowledgement, minor or major upgrades, pause/pin, blocked resume, secret rotation, supervisor self-update, or recovery acceptance. No tested rollback paths are advertised. Azure and GCP remain experimental and unvalidated by this approval.
